issues.description: The Person.firstName field has different visibility in the template and the solution: in the template it is declared private, while in the solution it is declared public. This inconsistency is structural (field visibility) and may confuse students about whether they should access the field directly or via the provided getter/setter methods.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent between template and solution. Prefer keeping the field private (as in the template) and access it via getFirstName()/setFirstName() everywhere. Update the solution's Person.firstName declaration to private to match the template and the intended encapsulation style.
